# Esther

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P19](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Esther Bell is described as being the very picture of health.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P43](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0043)_

## Personality

Esther is described as a dear girl, though she is known for being rather given to short-lived fads. Her personality is further characterized by a lack of imagination, alongside a tendency to suffer from indigestion.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)_

## Traits

- given to fads  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>
- lacks imagination  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>

## History

Esther was an eccentric neighbor in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) known for being a remarkably tidy woman. She was encountered by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) while they were canvassing the area for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P41](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0041), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), +30 more_
